title: Glimmer's Little Light
markdown:
In a meadow, where moonbeams loved to play, lived a little lantern. He was very new, and his light was just a tiny flicker. He sat quietly, a little shy, watching the sleepy sky.

One gentle evening, Rory the raccoon walked by. Rory had soft fur and happy ears. His fluffy tail twitched with joy. He saw the little lantern. "Hello, little lantern," Rory whispered. His voice was soft, like warm milk. "Why is your light so small tonight?"

The lantern's name was Glimmer. His little glass body shook just a tiny bit. "Oh, Rory," Glimmer whispered. "My light is just a tiny flicker. I wish it could be a little bit brighter, like the friendly fireflies. I feel a little sad."

Just then, Puddle the pond pixie floated near. Her wings were shiny, like a dragonfly's after rain. Puddle loved to hum happy songs, like tiny bells. "Sad feelings?" Puddle chirped, landing on a soft dewdrop. "We can help with sad feelings."

Rory nudged Glimmer with his soft nose. It was a warm touch. "We think your light is nice, Glimmer," Rory said softly. "Little lights make the meadow feel warm and safe, like a cozy nest."

Puddle hummed her sweetest song, like gentle whispers. "Imagine your light," Puddle said, "like a warm hug for the fireflies. Or a friendly wink for the sleepy flowers."

Glimmer thought about warm hugs. He pictured his light being like a soft hug. He pictured it being like a friendly wink. He took a tiny breath. Rory and Puddle watched him with kind eyes.

Then, a little warm glow started to bloom inside Glimmer. It was a soft, happy glow. Glimmer looked at his light. It was just right. "Oh!" Glimmer whispered. "My light is here!"

Rory smiled his gentle smile. "You found your light, Glimmer," he said softly.

Puddle hummed a soft, sleepy tune. The meadow was bathed in Glimmer's soft, warm glow. It made everything feel calm and sleepy. Rory yawned a big, quiet yawn. Puddle blinked her shiny wings. Glimmer's soft light made everyone feel sleepy. Soon, Glimmer drifted off to sweet, peaceful dreams, his gentle light glowing softly.
characters: Rory the raccoon, Puddle the pond pixie
